notes.title: Christmas Limited Edition!
notes.notes:
Hey! Enjoy this limited Christmas edition and burn fat while running & laughing!

Buy Log Challenge now and get ready for christmas party!

New look & new music score !!!

Log Challenge is an arcade game where you will have lots of fun in a 'quest for diamonds' action trying to collect as many diamonds as fast as you can moving through a dangerous plank while avoiding heavy swinging logs.

The faster you are, the more points you earn.

Are you the fastest in your family? Demonstrate to them all and be aware to not fall down!

Be ready for the challenge, enjoy it!
